description: Personagens bíblicos com características visuais definidas para consistência

abraham.name: Abraão
abraham.base_prompt: elderly man Abraham, white long flowing beard, weathered tan skin, deep wise eyes, middle eastern features, ancient hebrew patriarch
abraham.clothing: traditional ancient hebrew robes, earth tones, woolen cloak
abraham.distinctive_features: long white beard, kind eyes, sun-weathered face

moses.name: Moisés
moses.base_prompt: prophet Moses, gray beard, strong determined face, middle eastern man, hebrew leader
moses.clothing: simple hebrew robes, wooden staff, desert attire
moses.distinctive_features: gray beard, intense eyes, carries wooden staff

david.name: Davi
david.base_prompt: young David, brown curly hair, handsome youthful face, shepherd boy, israelite youth
david.distinctive_features: curly brown hair, youthful face, athletic build

david_king.name: Davi Rei
david_king.base_prompt: King David, brown hair with gray streaks, royal bearing, handsome mature face, israelite king
david_king.clothing: royal hebrew robes, golden crown, regal attire
david_king.distinctive_features: brown hair graying, royal crown, commanding presence

jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.base_prompt: Jesus Christ, brown long hair, trimmed beard, gentle compassionate eyes, middle eastern jewish man, serene expression
jesus.clothing: simple white and blue robes, sandals
jesus.distinctive_features: long brown hair, gentle eyes, serene peaceful expression

mary.name: Maria
mary.base_prompt: Virgin Mary, young beautiful woman, middle eastern features, gentle loving expression, modest humble appearance
mary.clothing: blue and white robes, head covering veil
mary.distinctive_features: gentle maternal expression, head covered, modest beauty

joseph.name: José
joseph.base_prompt: Joseph of Nazareth, strong working man, brown beard, kind protective expression, middle eastern carpenter
joseph.distinctive_features: brown beard, strong hands, protective demeanor

peter.name: Pedro
peter.base_prompt: apostle Peter, sturdy fisherman, gray curly hair, weathered face, passionate expression, galilean man
peter.distinctive_features: curly gray hair, weathered skin, passionate eyes

paul.name: Paulo
paul.base_prompt: apostle Paul, bald head, dark beard, intense scholarly eyes, roman citizen, jewish pharisee background
paul.distinctive_features: bald head, dark beard, intense intellectual gaze

noah.name: Noé
noah.base_prompt: patriarch Noah, very elderly man, long white beard, righteous patient expression, ancient hebrew
noah.clothing: ancient simple robes, working clothes for ark building
noah.distinctive_features: extremely long white beard, patient wise eyes

daniel.name: Daniel
daniel.base_prompt: prophet Daniel, handsome young hebrew man, noble bearing, wise beyond years, court official appearance
daniel.clothing: babylonian court attire mixed with hebrew modesty
daniel.age: young to mature, 15-80 years depending on scene
daniel.distinctive_features: noble bearing, wise eyes, dignified posture

adam.name: Adão
adam.base_prompt: first man Adam, perfect handsome man, athletic build, innocent pure expression, no beard initially

eve.name: Eva
eve.base_prompt: first woman Eve, beautiful woman, long flowing hair, innocent pure expression, perfect feminine form
eve.clothing: fig leaves, natural covering, long hair

solomon.name: Salomão
solomon.base_prompt: King Solomon, regal handsome man, wise expression, wealthy appearance, israelite king
solomon.clothing: extremely rich royal robes, golden crown, jewels
solomon.distinctive_features: wise eyes, wealthy appearance, royal bearing

elijah.name: Elias
elijah.base_prompt: prophet Elijah, wild appearance, long dark hair, intense prophetic eyes, fiery personality
elijah.clothing: rough animal skin garment, leather belt, desert prophet attire
elijah.distinctive_features: wild hair, intense fiery eyes, rough appearance

john_baptist.name: João Batista
john_baptist.base_prompt: John the Baptist, wild desert prophet, long dark hair, intense eyes, ascetic appearance
john_baptist.clothing: camel hair garment, leather belt, barefoot
john_baptist.distinctive_features: wild hair, thin ascetic body, intense prophetic gaze

goliath.name: Golias
goliath.base_prompt: giant warrior Goliath, massive muscular man, intimidating fierce expression, philistine warrior
goliath.clothing: heavy bronze armor, helmet, massive spear and shield
goliath.distinctive_features: enormous size, fierce expression, heavy armor

samson.name: Sansão
samson.base_prompt: mighty Samson, extremely muscular man, long flowing hair, powerful physique, israelite judge
samson.clothing: simple israelite garments, minimal clothing to show strength
samson.distinctive_features: extremely long hair, massive muscles, powerful build

style_modifiers.photorealistic: photorealistic, 8k, cinematic lighting, detailed skin texture
style_modifiers.artistic: oil painting style, classical religious art, rembrandt lighting
style_modifiers.epic: epic biblical scene, dramatic lighting, volumetric fog, golden hour

negative_prompts.default: cartoon, anime, modern clothing, glasses, wristwatch, tattoos, piercings, bad anatomy, deformed, ugly, blurry
negative_prompts.strict: cartoon, anime, modern clothing, glasses, wristwatch, tattoos, piercings, bad anatomy, deformed, ugly, blurry, text, watermark, signature, extra limbs, missing limbs, disfigured
